central_question: Bang-Jensen-Yeo (2004): is there an absolute constant K such that every K-arc-strong digraph D admits a strong arc decomposition (SAD) -- a partition A(D)=A_1 u A_2 with both (V,A_1) and (V,A_2) spanning and strongly connected (equivalently, every directed cut delta^+(X) is bichromatic)? The working conjecture under attack is WC3: K=3 suffices. Known: K=2 is FALSE (infinite obstruction families: C_{2k}^2, semicomplete compositions of Bang-Jensen-Gutin-Yeo 2020, split exceptions of Ai-He-Li-Qin-Wang 2024). No 3-arc-strong obstruction is known. Sub-goal the prior team drove at: prove SAD for structured 3-arc-strong classes (Eulerian, (1,0)-near-split) as stepping stones toward WC3.

benchmark.description: The fixed computational yardstick.
